newsitem.title: FRANCE: BA to name French unit Air Liberte.
newsitem.headline: BA to name French unit Air Liberte.

text.p: British Airways chief executive Bob Ayling said on Thursday that the merged group of its two French carriers TAT European Airlines and Air Liberte will be called Air Liberte and should be launched this year.

"I have confidence that within a year Marc Rochet and his management team are capable of relaunching the new group born from the merger under the colours of Air Liberte," he was quoted as saying in a statement released at a news conference.
The merged group represents about 22 percent of the French market from Orly airport, near Paris, and will be the second largest French domestic carrier with 2,500 staff and a fleet of 39 planes.
TAT and Air Liberte were brought under joint management on April 1 but no precise date for the official merger has yet been given.
